findings.passage: Nancy supports every citizen's right to take part in fair and free elections. She advocates for voter ID requirements that are inclusive and believes that stricter rules are unnecessary.
findings.note: Campaign site Voting Rights section, written in the third person on the campaign's behalf. Supports voter ID that is inclusive and says stricter rules are not needed.

findings.passage: Not everyone is able to vote conveniently in person on Election Day. Nancy believes in making voting easier by providing options such as early voting and mail-in voting.
findings.note: Same section. Favors early and mail-in voting options.
